scope.warning: Group-level catalog, not validated spawn commands or complete state-level scenes. F01-F136 additional investigations require separate mapping review.

groups.title: Client environment and resource reload
groups.prerequisites: Clean 1.21.1 NeoForge with current port at exact commit; record mod list, Java, shaders/CTM, resource-pack order, resolution, FOV and gamma; F3+T resource reload.
requiredObservations: client latest.log and reload warnings
manifest of mod/resource-pack versions
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: No errors for active models, OBJ loader, animation metadata; unresolved legacy syntax reported separately.

groups.title: Portal and device shaders
groups.prerequisites: Side-by-side recreated scenes in legacy 1.12.2 and modern 1.21.1 at matched positions, time, light and viewing angle.
requiredObservations: Hole open faces/sparkles from all four sides
Mirror and Essentia Mirror linked near/linked far/unlinked
Siphon redstone off/on at both shader heights
Hole initial tunnel 3x3 footprint
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Record exact shader/tunnel/state differences; GM-01 tagged gameplay, never silently fixed in V0.

groups.title: Arcane Bore mining beam
groups.prerequisites: Place operational Arcane Bore with mineable target and active digging sequence.
requiredObservations: first mining tick, mid-beam, end beam
beam color/width/endpoints and break FX
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Compare legacy beam1 textured quads and updated start/end points; no assumption from static device render.

groups.title: Flux Rift depth and motion
groups.prerequisites: Two stable rifts matched in size/stability, record goggles on/off and unstable/steady animation.
requiredObservations: 4 angle views
5–10s video of wobble, glow, depth and transparency
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Compare polycone passes, light and goggles depth; determine whether seed updates rebuild geometry.

groups.title: Four invisible-entity geometry gaps
groups.prerequisites: Use approved test harness or known-valid registry IDs to trigger focusmine, golem_dart, grapple and mind_spider; do not invent summon commands.
requiredObservations: focusmine color/pulse, dart 3D mesh, grapple head and moving rope
mind_spider translucent model from eligible/ineligible viewers
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Record visibility and motion against legacy; separate from projectile mechanics.

groups.title: Special armor silhouettes and UV
groups.prerequisites: Same player skin/FOV, compare 1.0/0.5 piece sets; test mask variants, goggles states, crouch/walk/idle.
requiredObservations: Fortress, Cultist Plate/Knight, Cultist Leader, Cultist Robe and Void Robe front/back/side
UV distortion and 128x64 atlas mapping video
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Classify missing custom geometry, mask/ornament motion and texture region alignment.

groups.title: Stairs geometry and face-texture continuity
groups.prerequisites: Build straight, inner and outer rotations for ancient and arcane stairs in matching light.
requiredObservations: same-frame adjacent stairs and inventory models
top/side/bottom image details
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Verify distinct source PNG selection, tile seams and shape consistency.

groups.title: GUI and HUD interaction sweep
groups.prerequisites: Prepare Arcane Spa, Potion Sprayer, Logistics, Golem Seal and compatible casting/focus gear.
requiredObservations: right-click and server-authoritative interaction outcomes
HUD both hands, multiple GUI scales, focus radial selector, seal area
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: For each legacy GUI either show functioning modern equivalent or record explicit deferred/missing with reproduction.

groups.title: FX burst and per-tick cadence
groups.prerequisites: Use consistent random seed where controllable; capture first 20 Nitor ticks and Taint Bottle/Seed impacts.
requiredObservations: Taint 100 burst legacy vs modern counts/sounds
Nitor core first-frame delay
Taint Seed geometry
wand beam/arc, Wisp zap and infusion/generic essentia streams
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Classify by caller/state, emission, motion and lifetime; dedicated preserved paths count positive but still runtime-unverified.

groups.title: Remaining dynamic tile animations
groups.prerequisites: Empty/active/full and rotation states for Hungry Chest, Centrifuge, Dioptra, Focal Manipulator, Alembic, One-way/Buffer Tubes, Pattern Crafter, Recharge Pedestal.
requiredObservations: Dioptra: vis/flux 13x13 mesh and top/side glows
Focal Manipulator: focus and aspect crystal orbit FX
Hungry Chest: custom texture/silhouette/lid
One-way and Buffer tubes: connected directional rods, choke colors
Alembic: filter label and dynamic nozzle
Centrifuge: rotor start/stop
Pattern Crafter: ten mode icons and two rotating gears
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Original vs port side-by-side video/screenshots in all state combinations; classify each source gap after live capture.

groups.title: Texture metadata / Thaumonomicon backgrounds
groups.prerequisites: Compare seven research pages with JPEG original vs modern PNG and animated seals; optionally CTM-enabled client only if supported.
requiredObservations: seven aligned 1024x1024 backgrounds
11 seal sprite sequences and tile joins
CTM vanilla vs enabled A/B
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Pixel/crop/tiling and timing checks; source byte fingerprints are not render equivalence.

groups.title: Item display and OBJ material smoke
groups.prerequisites: Compare held, item-frame and inventory displays plus crystals and OBJ machinery under matched lighting.
requiredObservations: Scribing tools pose; pure bucket icon
Thaumometer screen translucency and pane order
six crystals, Workbench Charger, Golem Builder, Thaumatorium
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Classify material coefficients, atlas alias and model parent behavior by effective render, not raw MTL differences.

groups.title: Registry orphans and world banners
groups.prerequisites: Use original world screenshot and current block/item registry dumps; test banners only if corresponding modern world blocks exist.
requiredObservations: 17 original banner place/render identity
double-slab 6 model states and old-save policy
relay/empty/helper block reachability and resource-load error state
groups.sourceAcceptanceNote: Classify missing world identities separately from dormant model files; no destructive old-save migration.
